title: Govee Soil Sensor Moisture Leaderboard
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=govee:soil moisture_pct=*
| stats sum(moisture_pct) as total_value, avg(moisture_pct) as avg_value by pot_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pot name values by total and average moisture across Govee soil sensor events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `moisture_pct` values for each Govee soil sensor event and review total and average moisture by pot name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total moisture.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which pot name shows the biggest moisture numbers in your Govee soil sensor data.
